stories.summary: To whoever takes the council seats after 4 November, regardless of party: you inherit a city whose residents have been carrying the load you were elected to carry. You owe them more than a thank-you post.

stories.summary: Founded by Malawian designer Xandria Kawanga, the House of Xandria is a socially conscious luxury fashion brand that makes high-end bespoke and ready-to-wear garments.

stories.summary: Conservationists, farmers and local communities are fighting to halt a multibillion-rand, high-polluting string of Chinese-owned factories planned for a pristine biodiverse corridor along the Limpopo River. The first coal pit has already been dug.

stories.summary: Voters are being bored to death by pathetic political party slogans and posters as we head for the seminal 4 November local government elections.

stories.summary: With 833 people seeking treatment, Bronkhorstspruit’s outbreak highlights how failures in water treatment and government leadership put vulnerable communities at risk.

stories.summary: Project Mayibuye should have been stopped before it started. Instead, the Gauteng High Court heard, the secret State Security Agency operation went ahead, targeted the EFF and had millions channelled through it.

stories.summary: Germany's political parties are weighing possible successors to President Frank-Walter Steinmeier, with no candidate agreed yet. Meanwhile, a poll suggests most Germans are giving Halloween a miss this year.

stories.summary: In shielding Europe's carmakers from Chinese rivals, the EU risks hurting close partners from Turkey and Morocco to Japan and South Korea. Billions in trade and hundreds of thousands of European jobs are at stake.
